description: Header file defining the TensorPipeAgent class and related structures for distributed RPC using TensorPipe in PyTorch, including transport/channel priorities, backend options, metrics, and group management.

classes.name: TransportRegistration
classes.description: Structure for registering tensorpipe transport contexts with priority and address.

classes.name: ChannelRegistration
classes.description: Structure for registering tensorpipe channel contexts with priority.

classes.name: TensorPipeRpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for TensorPipe RPC backend, including threads, transports, channels, timeout, and devices.

classes.name: TensorPipeAgent
classes.description: Main class implementing a distributed RPC agent using TensorPipe, supporting message sending, group management, metrics, and error handling.

classes.name: NetworkSourceInfo
classes.description: Struct for tracking source network metrics.

classes.name: AggregatedNetworkData
classes.description: Struct for tracking aggregated network metrics such as call count and bytes transferred.

classes.name: AtomicJitFuture
classes.description: Helper struct for managing the state of a future RPC response with atomic completion flag.

classes.name: ClientPipe
classes.description: Struct managing a client-side tensorpipe pipe, including response tracking and error state.

classes.name: TimeSeriesMetricsTracker
classes.description: Class for tracking time-series metrics like GIL wait time, maintaining sum and count for averaging.

classes.name: GroupMembershipLockGuard
classes.description: RAII guard for locking group membership mutex based on static/dynamic group status.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send a message to a remote worker with optional timeout and device mapping.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Join the agent's operation, optionally shutting down.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronize the agent (no-op).

methods.name: startImpl
methods.description: Start the agent implementation.

methods.name: shutdownImpl
methods.description: Shutdown the agent implementation.

methods.name: getWorkerInfo
methods.description: Retrieve WorkerInfo by worker name or ID.

methods.name: getWorkerInfos
methods.description: Retrieve all WorkerInfo objects.

methods.name: updateGroupMembership
methods.description: Update group membership with new worker info and device list.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieve current metrics as key-value pairs.

methods.name: addGilWaitTime
methods.description: Add GIL wait time measurement.

methods.name: getBackendOptions
methods.description: Get current backend options.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Get the associated store.

methods.name: getDeviceMap
methods.description: Get device mapping for a destination worker.

methods.name: getDevices
methods.description: Get local devices used by the agent.

methods.name: getNetworkData
methods.description: Retrieve network metrics data.

methods.name: getNetworkSourceInfo
methods.description: Retrieve network source info.

methods.name: guessAddress
methods.description: Guess the agent's address.

methods.name: timeoutMapSize
methods.description: Get size of the timeout map for testing.

methods.name: numPendingResponses
methods.description: Get number of pending responses for testing.

methods.name: messageIdToTimeoutMapSize
methods.description: Get size of message ID to timeout map for testing.
